description: backend.rs SetError struct (line 55) has no max_size: Option<u64> field and no with_max_size() builder. RFC 8621 §7.5 says: 'A maxSize UnsignedInt property MUST be present on the SetError specifying the maximum size of a message that may be sent, in octets' whenever a backend returns TooLarge for an EmailSubmission. Because SetError is #[non_exhaustive] and serialized by serde, a backend cannot currently express this mandatory field. Fix: add pub max_size: Option<u64> with serde rename maxSize and a with_max_size(n: u64) builder.
title: SetError missing max_size for tooLarge
